stories.title: Caleb Williams’ TD pass with 3 seconds left gives Bears 39-35 win over Lions
stories.summary: Williams led the way, completing 30 of 44 passes for 345 yards with two touchdown passes after trailing by 11 points midway through the fourth quarter.

stories.title: Zelenskyy warns of imminent major Russian attack on Ukraine’s power grid
stories.summary: Meanwhile, U.S. envoy Jared Kushner says Russian President Vladimir Putin has shown restraint by agreeing not to use nuclear weapons, though peace talks remain deadlocked over Ukrainian territory.

stories.title: Necessities join gifts in Black Friday shopping carts as AI and higher costs steer spending
stories.summary: Industry analysts say AI-powered shopping tools and cost concerns fueled by the U.S. war with Iran also are influencing where, when, on what and how much consumers are spending.

stories.title: Curious Alaska: How are Anchorage traffic lights timed and who operates them?
stories.summary: The city’s Traffic Engineering department operates and maintains a total of 282 signals, using various techniques to keep vehicles moving.

stories.title: Trump calls the pre-election GDP figures ‘fake’ and demands an investigation of Commerce Department
stories.summary: Trump is suggesting without evidence a conspiracy within the government to report upwardly revised economic growth figures after the midterm elections that were disastrous for Republicans.

stories.title: French cinema star Gérard Depardieu ordered to stand trial for rape and sexual assault
stories.summary: Actress Charlotte Arnould was 22 when she accused Depardieu in 2018 of raping her at his Paris home.

stories.title: Heavy rain, wind and flooding plague much of U.S. on Thanksgiving holiday
stories.summary: A strengthening storm in the northeast forced the postponement of Macy’s 100th Thanksgiving Day Parade to Saturday. On the West Coast, strong winds and king tides flooded communities.

stories.title: National GOP consultant asserts he was misled into boosting minor candidates in Alaska’s U.S. Senate race
stories.summary: Wisconsin-based consultant Thomas Datwyler served as treasurer for two political action committees that spent millions supporting fringe candidates who challenged Republican incumbent Sen. Dan Sullivan.

stories.title: How long Thanksgiving leftovers actually last — and the best way to store them
stories.summary: It’s tempting to hold onto all that delicious food until you can eat through it. But food safety experts want you to rethink that.

stories.title: Top official admits ‘wrong decisions’ and ‘deaths’ will result from U.S. wildfire shake-up
stories.summary: The Trump administration’s push to rapidly reshape how the nation responds to wildfires will lead to mistakes that could cost lives, Michael Boren said this month.

stories.title: China and other US trading partners hit back at Trump’s new tariff plans
stories.summary: Analysts say the tariffs will likely have a limited impact though they may push prices higher.

stories.title: Letter: Blanket snow days end up hurting Anchorage families
